lines.3: Even though this was English--in other words, Miss Inori's class.
lines.4: I was kind, so I left her undisturbed.
lines.6: 「Awake, are we? Then it is time for your punishment.」
lines.8: 「You slept for approximately twenty minutes, so I will prepare twenty pages of homework for you.」
lines.9: 「Twenty pages?! P-Please give me a discount, ma'am!」
lines.12: 「If you fail to complete it... you will be banished to an island.」
lines.13: 「I-I'll do it! I'll be happy to do it!」
lines.14: Miss Inori never forgave anyone who did whatever they pleased in her class.
lines.16: Her expression was gentle, but her methods were harsh.
